subject: Edge node licensing, platform-fee grace, and usage thresholds
messages:
From: Claire Dawson <claire@novushealth.com>
To: ben_carter <ben@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-05T10:12:00Z
Subject: Edge node licensing — clarify platform fee credits

Hi Ben / Marissa,

Thanks for the walkthrough earlier. We captured our prioritized constraints in the attached Novus-VPC-Requirements.pdf but wanted a couple of clarifications before we take this to procurement: 

1) Licensing model for edge nodes: our sites will run small GPU nodes (1xA10s and some A100-lite). Is Redwood recommending a per-seat operator license, a per-node license, or a hybrid? For forecasting we need to model both 1) a flat per-site node fee and 2) a per-seat (SRE) fee.

2) Platform fee amortization / grace: for a 4-month pilot across 12 sites, can the platform fee be amortized or credited? We typically push for a pilot grace period or a partial credit if we convert to full deployment.

3) Usage thresholds and discounts: what thresholds trigger tiered discounts? We expect variable token usage during pilot and would like a simple rule we can include in the SOW so procurement can approve.

If you can sketch out 1-page pricing options for the pilot vs full deploy (including any one-time install credits for on-prem engineers), that will speed things up. Procurement is copied on this thread (procurement@novushealth.com).

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if that helps.

Claire Dawson
Director, Cloud Operations
Novus Health

> Thanks for the walkthrough earlier. We captured our prioritized constraints in the attached Novus-VPC-Requirements.pdf but wanted a couple of clarifications before we take this to procurement:

> 1) Licensing model for edge nodes...

Hi Claire — appreciate the details and the PDF. High level answers below and we can follow with a short SOW draft: 

- Licensing recommendation: hybrid model works best for workloads like yours. We propose a per-node license for runtime (covers inference on each GPU node) + a small per-seat operator license for SREs who need admin access. The per-node license protects you from per-seat explosion where many engineers query the system during validation.

- Pilot platform fee: for pilots under 6 months we can offer a 50% platform-fee credit applied at contract signing; if you convert to a 12-month commitment we rebate the remainder (so pilot effectively amortized). For multi-site pilots we offer a 3-month grace window for onboarding credits tied to milestone acceptance.

- Usage thresholds: shorthand tiers we use internally: up to 500k tokens/month (pilot tier), 500k–5M tokens/month (growth tier), >5M tokens (production). Discounts scale at the start of each tier; for private deployments we anchor discounts to committed GPU-hours rather than raw tokens. We will provide concrete numeric examples for your expected profile.

I've attached a quick workbook (redwood-platfee-tiering.xlsx) with the 3 scenarios: pilot (4 months), 12-mo conversion, and full deploy.

Next steps: Marissa, can you pull the standard SOW language for pilot crediting and confirm the on-prem install credit mechanics (hours vs fixed)? If Claire/procurement are happy we can produce a one-page SOW + indicative commercial the same day.

Best,
Ben Carter

Claire — outlining a concrete set of commercial options so procurement has actionable choices. Happy to jump on a 30m call but sending the options inline to keep momentum.

Option A — Pilot-first (recommended for Novus):
- Term: 4-month pilot across 12 sites
- Licensing: per-node runtime license = EUR 1,250 / node / month for A10-class nodes; A100-lite nodes priced at EUR 2,500 / node / month (node license includes runtime + KV cache allowances).
- Seats: Operator seat license = EUR 150 / seat / month (SREs only). 3 seats included for the pilot.
- Platform fee: Standard platform fee EUR 10,000 / month; Pilot credit = 50% for pilot months (applied as credit on first invoice). If converted to 12-mo committed term within 90 days of pilot end, remaining 50% credited back over first 6 months of term.
- On-prem install credit: 40 engineer-hours complimentary (applied during pilot). Additional hours at discounted rate EUR 160 / hour.
- Support: Silver tier during pilot (8x5, 4-hour P1, monthly health checks).
- Discount triggers: If committed GPU-hours > 2,000 GPU-hours/month at conversion we apply an additional 10% rebate on node license line.

Option B — Accelerated conversion:
- Term: 12 months start-of-contract
- Licensing: 10% lower node rates compared to pilot list above
- Platform fee: full fee invoiced, but can be amortized across 3 invoices on request
- Support: Gold tier (24x7, 1-hour P1) optionally addable for EUR 6,000 / month

Operational notes:
- We anchor discounts to committed GPU-hours rather than raw token volumes for private deploys to avoid token-metering anomalies.
- We can provide an SLA addendum for failover between regions and a 99.5% availability target for inference serving; on-prem failover within a site requires a documented DR plan and optional on-call top-up.

DocuSign link (indicative commercial + SOW): https://docusign.com/ABCD-1234
